arStrings.szText: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.

Increase the potency of your {c_important}Hex{/c} Effects by {c_random}[SF_3*100|+x%|]{/c}.{if:SF_2} Additionally, enemies afflicted with any of your {c_important}Hex{/c} Effects have a {c_number}[SF_5*100|+%|]{/c} increased chance to be Critically Struck.{/if}
Increase the Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}[SF_5*100|+%|]{/c} against enemies afflicted by your {c_important}Hex{/c} Effects.
